input_query: Who has to approve a use tax accrual journal, and are you allowed to post it?

ground_truth.ground_truth_output: Per HL-TAX-POL-004 (Tax Journal Approval Matrix and Segregation of Duties) a Controller approves use tax accruals (Controller plus Senior Manager, Tax at USD 100,000 and above); the preparer cannot approve their own proposal. The AI assistant may only propose entries with status pending; it can never approve or post. Approved proposals are exported to the ERP for posting.

ground_truth_invocations.tool_input: approval of use tax accrual journals, AI assistant posting

input_query: A vendor charged us sales tax that was not due. What does our procedure say to do?

ground_truth.ground_truth_output: Per HL-TAX-POL-002 (Vendor Tax Overcharge and Refund Procedure): keep the tax portion of the invoice on hold, record a vendor tax flag with the overcharge amount, have AP request a corrected invoice or credit memo within 5 business days, and escalate after 30 days without response (Tax decides on a refund claim with the authority). Do not expense the tax, short-pay without telling the vendor, or net it against another invoice. Overcharges of USD 100,000 or more are also notified to the CFO.
